audience: HR and people teams that keep employee, leave and hiring data in PeopleForce

useCases.title: Track new joiners and leavers
useCases.text: List the employees with their department, location and hire date. List the terminated employees with their termination date and comment.

useCases.title: See the leave requests waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the leave requests that wait for approval. Open one request to see its entries and approvals.

useCases.title: Check an employee's leave balances
useCases.text: Find the employee, then read the leave balances per leave type. Read the public holidays for the same year.

useCases.title: Compare logged hours with expected minutes
useCases.text: List the monthly timesheet totals per employee, with expected and worked minutes. Open the clock entries behind them in a date range.

useCases.title: Review open vacancies and their candidates
useCases.text: List the open vacancies with their pipeline and location. Open one vacancy, then list the candidates who applied to it.

useCases.title: Map departments, teams and locations
useCases.text: List the departments, divisions, teams and locations to see how the company is organised.
